'''Ollopoms''' were aquatic rodents that lived on the surface of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan Swamp|Swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:Ollopom_2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ollopom with young]]

These short, gentle, dense, green-furred rodents were camouflaged to blend in with the [[Pom petal|Pom Petals]] whose edges they fed upon. On their underside, they had gnawing teeth and three pairs of paddle-like claws. Their flukes were used as rudders. Long, bloom-like tendrils grew from their head follicles to mimic Pom Petals. When Pom Petals bloomed, so did sympathetic ollopom ''hair blossoms''.<ref name=":0" />

Ollopoms were typically preyed upon by [[otta]]s.<ref name=":0" />

Young ollopoms rode on their mother's tail.<ref name=":0" />
